versions.changelog:
- Initial release of review-radar skill.
- Enables extraction of structured monitor review data from Bilibili/YouTube video links.
- Supports single and batch video analysis, manual text fallback, and report database search.
- Generates review cards with test data, pros/cons, conclusions, and competitor mentions.
- Reports include original reference, timestamp, validation status, and source type.
- Offers guidance for synthesizing insights across multiple reviews for product analysis.
